decision: Exclude unreferenced master-file-table and record-lock structures from the selected core build and retain them under research.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
No include of mft.inc was found in retained BIOS, DOS, COMMAND and include source trees or the frozen selected dependency inventory.
Representative MFT and RLR structure symbols occur only within this file in those retained source trees.
limitations: Exclusion is limited to the selected core build; it does not establish that MFT definitions were absent from other DOS components or configurations.
